params.name: length (frames)
params.meaning: pixel frames; latent frames = (length-1)//8+1; must be 8n+1 (1, 9, 17, ... 121 ...); the audio latent length is derived from frames_number and frame_rate

defaults.2.3 T2V/I2V/FLF2V: 5 x 25 + 1 = 126 -> floored by the node to 121
defaults.IC-LoRA: frame count of the control video (GetImageSize.batch_size), cropped to 8n+1 by LTXVAddGuide

params.interactions: LTXVDurationPredictor (Auto Duration) snaps to 8k+1 between 1 and 20 s; partner API: 2-20 s; 10 s on 24 GB needs tile_size 512 for the diffusion decoder

params.name: width / height
params.meaning: pixels; latent = /32; divisible by 32 (cards; node step 32). Two-stage graphs sample stage 1 at width/2 x height/2 then LTXVLatentUpsampler x2
params.interactions: 720 is not 32-aligned: EmptyLTXVLatentVideo floors it to 704 (the recipes write 704)

params.name: frame_rate
params.meaning: written into the conditioning and used to size the audio latent; CreateVideo.fps must match

params.name: sigmas (distilled schedule)
params.meaning: the distilled models run a FIXED schedule: stage 1 '1.0, 0.99375, 0.9875, 0.98125, 0.975, 0.909375, 0.725, 0.421875, 0.0' (8 steps); stage 2 after the x2 upscale '0.85, 0.7250, 0.4219, 0.0' (3 steps); IC-LoRA/Ingredients templates use KSampler 8 steps linear_quadratic instead
params.interactions: diffusers DISTILLED_SIGMA_VALUES identical; its STAGE_2 list is [0.909375, 0.725, 0.421875] (Comfy starts stage 2 at 0.85) - both recorded; do not add CFG > 1 to distilled

params.name: steps (dev / full model)
params.meaning: normal flow-matching schedule for the non-distilled model; not used by any template

defaults.node: 20 steps, max_shift 2.05, base_shift 0.95, stretch true, terminal 0.1

params.interactions: GitHub README: 'Use gradient estimation - Reduce inference steps from 40 to 20-30'; dev + distilled LoRA (2.3 at 0.5; 2.5 lora-450) -> distilled sigmas instead

params.name: cfg
params.meaning: classifier-free guidance; LTXVDualCFGGuider has separate video and audio scales (equal scales fall back to plain CFG)
params.interactions: at 1.0 the negative prompt is inert (unconditional pass skipped); raise only with the dev model/schedule

params.name: STG / modality guidance
params.meaning: optional extra guidance passes (not in any template): STG scale 1.0 on block '29'; modality_scale 3.0 severs a2v/v2a cross-attention for the extra pass; 'Stacks with the dual-CFG guider and STG'
params.interactions: each is one more forward pass; Ingredients card validated with STG stg_v block 29 scale 1.0 on the full model

params.name: sampler
params.interactions: pipelines' TI2VidTwoStagesHQ uses res_2s (not in Comfy templates)

params.name: strength
params.meaning: how hard a conditioning frame is held: sets the noise mask (1 - strength) on the conditioned latent frames

params.name: img_compression
params.meaning: H.264 CRF re-encode of the conditioning image 'matching the compression the model was trained against'; 0 disables

params.name: seed
params.meaning: stage-1 noise; the templates fix stage-2 noise at 42

params.name: tiled decode
params.interactions: HF #15: tile 768->512 fixed a 10 s freeze on a 3090; temporal 64/16 on a 16 GB card; or swap to ltx-2.5-video-vae-conv-bf16; smaller tiles cost time

params.name: distilled LoRA strength (2.3 dev)
params.meaning: the distilled-1.1 LoRA on the dev-fp8 checkpoint
params.interactions: paired with CFG 1 and the fixed sigmas

params.name: IC-LoRA strength
params.meaning: 'controls how strongly the IC-LoRA guide is followed'
params.interactions: GetICLoRAParameters must be wired for ref0.5 LoRAs

params.name: identity_guidance_scale
params.interactions: 'Set to 0 to disable (no extra pass)'; reference audio ~5 s recommended (training duration)

params.name: prompt enhancer
params.meaning: optional LLM rewrite of a short prompt (not in the recipes): 2.5 uses gemma4_e2b_it_int8_convrot (CLIPLoader ltxv), 2.3 the Gemma-3 encoder + abliterated LoRA

defaults.2.5: max_length 600, temp 0.7, top_k 64, top_p 0.95, min_p 0.05, repetition 1.15

params.interactions: off by default in the 2.5 templates, ON in 2.3 T2V/IA2V; 'adds about 1-2 minutes'; HF #36: unrelated generations / empty text when enabled; its own system prompt says a detailed prompt should not be heavily edited

rules.message: LTX frame counts are 8n+1 (num_frames % 8 == 1): 121 = 5 s @24 fps; 126 is silently floored to 121 by EmptyLTXVLatentVideo and guide videos are cropped to 8n+1 by LTXVAddGuide
LTX sizes are multiples of 32 (latent /32): 1280x704, not 1280x720 (720 floors to 704); 'the input should be padded with -1 and then cropped' otherwise
the audio latent is sized from frames_number and frame_rate: it must equal the video length or the AV latent lengths disagree (the 2.5 templates derive both from one duration x fps + 1 expression)
LTXVConditioning.frame_rate, LTXVEmptyLatentAudio.frame_rate and CreateVideo.fps are one value in every template (24 for 2.5, 25 for 2.3); a mismatch desyncs audio and playback speed

LTX-2.x is an audio-video model: the video latent must pass through LTXVConcatAVLatent(video, audio) before the sampler and LTXVSeparateAVLatent after it; a bare video latent into the sampler gives no audio and the wrong latent shape
LTX prompts go through LTXVConditioning (adds frame_rate to both conditionings) between CLIPTextEncode and the guider; every template has it
distilled LTX (2.5 distilled transformer, 2.3 distilled checkpoint, dev + distilled LoRA) = 'Fixed 8-step schedule, CFG=1'; every template runs cfg 1 (dual 1/1)
distilled schedules are fixed: 8 sigmas (stage 1), 3 sigmas (stage 2 after x2 upscale) or KSampler 8 steps linear_quadratic; other step counts are off-distribution

LTX-2.5 encodes text with its own Gemma 4 12B 'with-proj' file (int8 15.4 GB or bf16 26.3 GB); 'Google's stock Gemma 4 release is not a substitute: loading checks the encoder's version against the one the checkpoint was trained with'; Gemma 3 is the 2.3 encoder
the LTX Gemma encoders load with CLIPLoader type 'ltxv'

the 2.5 split pack decodes with ltx-2.5-video-vae-bf16 (diffusion decoder, template) or ltx-2.5-video-vae-conv-bf16 (lighter conv decoder) - the 2.3 VAE lives inside the 2.3 checkpoint and is not a file here
LTXVEmptyLatentAudio / LTXVAudioVAEDecode need the 2.5 audio VAE + vocoder loaded with a second VAELoader

LTX-2.3 encodes text with Gemma 3 12B through LTXAVTextEncoderLoader(text_encoder, ckpt_name) - the text projection is read from the checkpoint ('Recipes: ltxav: gemma 3 12B or matching gemma 4 model')

every 2.3 template gives the SAME single-file checkpoint to CheckpointLoaderSimple, LTXVAudioVAELoader (audio_vae./vocoder. keys) and LTXAVTextEncoderLoader (text projection); mixing dev and distilled files across the three loaders is untested

LTX-2.5 ships 'a split, Comfy-aligned pack': transformer in diffusion_models/ (UNETLoader), video + audio VAE in vae/ (VAELoader), Gemma 4 in text_encoders/ (CLIPLoader ltxv) - there is no single-file 2.5 checkpoint

the LTX-2.3 single-file checkpoints (transformer + VAEs + text projection) load with CheckpointLoaderSimple from checkpoints/, not UNETLoader (only Kijai's *_transformer_only_bf16 split is a UNETLoader file, used by pack-dependent templates)
a 2.5 LoRA belongs on a 2.5 transformer: 'a LoRA only works with the model it was trained on'

a 2.3 LoRA on a 2.5 model: 'the large majority of LoRAs and IC-LoRAs trained on LTX-2.3 run on LTX-2.5 without changes. A small number of exceptions exist - validate your adapters'; the 2.3 ID-LoRAs changed the subject's identity on 2.5 (HF #30)
LTX-2 19B LoRAs (IC-LoRA canny/depth/pose, camera-control, squish, distilled-lora-384) were trained on the 19B legacy model, not on the 22B 2.3/2.5 transformers

an IC-LoRA guide needs GetICLoRAParameters(iclora_model) -> LTXVAddGuide.iclora_parameters: it reads the reference_downscale_factor from the LoRA metadata ('This model expects a reference downscale factor of 0.5'; Ingredients: 1); 'a generic LoRA loader that ignores the reference path will not apply the conditioning'

guided graphs (FLF2V keyframes, IC-LoRA control frames, reference sheets) append guide latents: LTXVCropGuides(positive, negative, latent) must sit between the sampler's video latent and the decode, or the guide frames appear in the output; the 2.3 two-stage graphs also feed CropGuides' conditioning to the stage-2 guider
the single-stage guided templates (FLF2V, style transition) take SamplerCustomAdvanced.denoised_output (slot 1), not output (slot 0), into LTXVSeparateAVLatent
the 2.5 templates pair the 2.5 x2 spatial upsampler with the 2.5 transformer (2.3: ltx-2.3-spatial-upscaler-x2-1.1); cross-generation use is NOT FOUND
LTX-2.5 conditioning images are recompressed at CRF 18 (all 2.5 templates; diffusers LTX2_5_IMAGE_CRF = 18); the node default 35 is the pre-2.5 value
the Ingredients reference sheet is looped into a static video of at least 121 frames ('shorter references break the reference-encoding bucket')
the 2.5 diffusion video decoder is heavy ('roughly 500x more tokens for a 1080p, 121-frame video'): a 10 s clip froze on a 24 GB card until tile_size 768 -> 512; keep 512 or use the conv VAE
all converted LTX templates need <= 0.32.0 (pinned image 0.35.0); nothing pending for version

positive.line: Official structure (GitHub README 'Prompting for LTX-2'): 'detailed, chronological descriptions of actions and scenes. Include specific movements, appearances, camera angles, and environmental details - all in a single flowing paragraph. Start directly with the action, and keep descriptions literal and precise. Think like a cinematographer describing a shot list. Keep within 200 words.'

Order: main action in one sentence -> specific movements and gestures -> character/object appearance -> background and environment -> camera angles and movements -> lighting and colors -> changes or sudden events

docs.comfy.org 2.5: 'Describe the whole scene: Include the shot type, scene, action, characters, and camera movement in one flowing paragraph'; 'Audio: Describe sounds and dialogue needed for the scene'. 2.3 tips: Core Actions / Visual Details / Audio

I2V: 'Describe what happens next ... do not re-describe what is already visible'; anchor with 'Use the provided start image as the first frame'. FLF2V: 'Describe the transition ... Keep frames aligned: Use images with the same aspect ratio'

Training-caption style (ComfyUI's LTX-2.5 enhancer system prompt): begin immediately with the action (no 'The scene opens...'); objective observable description; per shot exactly one shot type (extreme wide / wide / medium / medium close-up / close-up / extreme close-up), the camera motion ('if none, explicitly say the camera remains static') and the viewpoint (front-facing / back-facing / side view / over-the-shoulder / top-down / low-angle / high-angle); a complete soundscape with dialogue quoted exactly in the original language, tone of voice, music, environmental sounds; chronological flow ('Initially...', 'A moment later...', 'Simultaneously...'); one paragraph of roughly 150-220 words; no labels like 'Audio:'. I2V adds 'Single continuous take - no hard cuts'
Dialogue is quoted inside the prose: 'She stops ... and says: "The old gods are silent. I am not."' (2.5 I2V template); 'speaks with a deep male voice and a satisfied tone, saying, ...' (GitHub)

ID-LoRA: three tagged sections - '[VISUAL]: shot type, appearance, setting, lighting, actions (say the person is speaking to avoid voice-overs)' / '[SPEECH]: the exact transcript, not a summary' / '[SOUNDS]: tone, volume, mic proximity, ambience and music'
IA2V template: a prose sentence then labelled lines 'scene:' / 'character:' / 'action:' / 'camera:'

Ingredients: two labelled parts - '### Reference Sheet Description' (inventory the panels: characters, props, location) then '### Target Description' (the action); card form 'Reference sheet: ... / Generated video: ...'
Style transition LoRA: shot description, subject and environment, the transformation over time, visual details, then the trigger 'zhuanchang' near the end

Multishot (2.5, partner docs for the hosted Pro model): 'cut between two and four distinct shots' in 'one flowing paragraph'; name every transition in prose ('A hard cut transitions to', 'a match cut connects', 'the image dissolves into') - 'Without these markers, the model interprets camera movement within a single shot rather than an edit'; after each cut re-establish scale, angle, who is in frame and lighting; state audio continuity ('the engine note continuing across the cut'); 'two to four shots fit an 8 or 10 second clip'. Official syntax NOT FETCHED (ltx.io guide blocked)

Camera / motion vocabulary in official material: push-in, pull back, dolly out, static camera, side-tracking shot, slow forward dolly shot, medium close-up, shallow depth of field, 'the camera remains static'; Gemma-3 enhancer rule: 'DO NOT invent camera motion unless requested', no timestamps or scene cuts unless requested

prompting.structure: action first, one flowing paragraph of 150-220 words: shot type + camera motion + viewpoint, subject appearance, movements in chronological order, environment, lighting, then the full soundscape with exact quoted dialogue

hurts.line: H3-style timestamped shot lists and 'Audio:' labels (the 2.5 enhancer forbids labels; cuts must be named in prose)
relying on the negative prompt: it is inert at cfg 1 (every template)
very short prompts without the prompt enhancer: 'Prompt following is heavily influenced by prompting style' (cards)
describing a cut without a transition marker: read as camera movement inside one shot

pitfalls.cause: Lightricks/LTX-2.5 (and the 2.5 IC-LoRA, 2.3 Ingredients, Pre-Trained repos) are gated
pitfalls.fix: accept the model terms on HF and log in with a Read token ('read gated repos' scope); Comfy-Org mirrors (ltx-2.3, ltx-2, gemma-4) are open

pitfalls.symptom: 10 s LTX-2.5 clip freezes / hangs in VAE decode on 24 GB
pitfalls.cause: the diffusion video decoder's token count
pitfalls.fix: VAEDecodeTiled tile_size 512 (fixed it on a 3090); temporal_size 64 / temporal_overlap 16 (5070 Ti 16 GB); or load ltx-2.5-video-vae-conv-bf16

pitfalls.symptom: prompt enhancer gives unrelated videos or empty text (2.5)
pitfalls.cause: HF #36: LLM returns empty text; in I2V the loaded image context bleeds into T2V
pitfalls.fix: keep prompt_enhance off and write the long prompt yourself (the recipes do); if used, preview the text, enable thinking, use gemma4_e2b_it_int8_convrot

pitfalls.symptom: 'AssertionError: Input and weight inner dimensions must match' (2.5 template)
pitfalls.cause: HF #64, unresolved; reporter questioned the 1368x768 -> 1536 resize path
pitfalls.fix: keep sizes 32-aligned (the recipes scale to width x height); single-source

pitfalls.symptom: wrong face / changed ethnicity with an ID-LoRA on 2.5
pitfalls.fix: run ID-LoRA on 2.3 (id-lora-2.3); 'wait for the face id lora of ltx2.5'

pitfalls.symptom: model fails to load / shape errors after mixing files
pitfalls.cause: 2.3 single-file checkpoints vs 2.5 split pack; LoRA from the other generation; stock Gemma 4
pitfalls.fix: 2.3: checkpoints/ + CheckpointLoaderSimple + LTXVAudioVAELoader + LTXAVTextEncoderLoader(Gemma 3); 2.5: diffusion_models/ + vae/ + text_encoders/ with UNETLoader, VAELoader, CLIPLoader ltxv

pitfalls.symptom: int8 convrot file slow or failing
pitfalls.cause: INT8 ConvRot needs ComfyUI >= 0.27.0 (community: comfy-kitchen >= 0.2.16, cu130 PyTorch); issues #14824 (slower than fp8 on A100 with cu130) and #16431 (fails on Turing for M=97..127) exist
pitfalls.fix: Comfy-Org: 'prefer int8_convrot if you are able to use pytorch with cu130. fp8_scaled should only be used if you cannot use int8_convrot'; on a 2.3 box use the fp8 checkpoints
expected; raise video_cfg/audio_cfg only with the dev model and a real schedule

pitfalls.symptom: length rejected or off-by-a-few frames; odd sizes
pitfalls.cause: frames not 8n+1 / sizes not multiples of 32; LTXVAddGuide frame_idx on 9+ frame guides must be divisible by 8

pitfalls.symptom: extra frames or garbage at the end of a guided clip
pitfalls.fix: wire LTXVCropGuides before the decode (recipes do)

pitfalls.symptom: black / grey / garbled frames, OOM on 2.3 fp8
pitfalls.cause: community guides: mixed precisions (fp8 checkpoint with fp16-forced VAE/text encoder) or the wrong VAE; full-precision encoder/VAE push peak memory
pitfalls.fix: offloading, 768x512, fewer frames (65 instead of 161) - single-source

pitfalls.cause: GetICLoRAParameters not wired, or control frames not frame-aligned with the latent
pitfalls.fix: iclora_parameters -> LTXVAddGuide; frame count from the control video (GetImageSize.batch_size); strength 1

pitfalls.cause: small or cluttered panels; element absent from the sheet; reference < 121 frames
pitfalls.fix: bigger clean panels on black with no text; a face close-up + turnaround per character; >= 121 looped frames; card recommends strength 1.4
describe music/SFX explicitly; or supply the audio (ia2v-2.3)

pitfalls.cause: the 32-px latent grid floors 720 (and ResolutionSelector's 736) to 704
